Rooms.Name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow trail winding its way between the enormous, gray trunks.
The crowns of the trees must be very dense, as they leave the forest floor in
utter darkness. The trail leads east and west.

Exits.Description: The narrow trail leads east to a somewhat lighter part of the forest.
The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant gray roots have broken up through its surface.

These ancient trees must have been here for many, many years.  It is impossible
to catch even a glimpse of anything above the lowest branches.

Rooms.Name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge, ancient
trees whose gray trunks remind you of ancient pillars in a enormous, deserted
hall. To the south, a frail path leads away from the trail.

Exits.Description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.
The path leads south - away from the trail.
The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant gray roots have broken up through its surface.

The path seems fragile and unsafe compared to the enormous trunks that loom
around it.

These ancient trees must have been here for many, many years.  It is impossible
to catch even a glimpse of anything above the lowest branches.

Rooms.Name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way westward between huge, ancient
trees that stand close on all sides. The tree trunks seem to be covered in some
sticky substance which gets much stickier towards the west! Beware!

Exits.Description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.

The sticky substance is hanging like ropes between the trees just above the
path. To the west the path seems to be covered with these giant threads covered
with glue. You can sense the forces of evil coming from the west and your bones
tell you it may not be such a good idea to proceed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The substance reminds you of giant threads covered with glue.  If it hadn't
been for the size you could have sworn it was part of a spider web.

The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant gray roots have broken up through its surface.

The sticky substance is hanging like ropes between the ancient trees, crossing
the path just out of reach.  It might be possible to climb one of the sticky
trunks.

Rooms.Name: The deadly spider web
Rooms.Description:
You are walking along the narrow path, ducking under the sticky ropes as you
advance... > A huge, poisonous spider drops from above! A huge, poisonous
spider drops from above! A huge, poisonous spider drops from above! > The huge,
poisonous spider stings you! You resist the poison! The huge, poisonous spider
stings you! You are poisoned! The huge, poisonous spider stings you! You are
poisoned!

Rooms.Name: Up in the tree
Rooms.Description:
You are hanging on the outside of a huge tree trunk covered in a sticky
substance. Directly to the west is an immense spider web suspended between
numerous of the giant trees including the one you are hanging on. To the north
is what looks like a large webbed entrance.

Exits.Description:
To the north is what looks like a large expanse of webbing which extends very
far into the trees.
To the west is the immense spider web. It seems to move softly.
Downwards is the narrow forest path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The spider web stretches out to the west.  It looks as if it is possible to
walk on it.

Rooms.Name: On the spider web
Rooms.Description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place. To the east is a giant tree trunk and to the west is an entrance
to a cave-like structure made from many layers of spider web.

Exits.Description: To the east is the giant tree trunk.
To the west is the entrance to the cave-like structure.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The immense spider web moves softly.

It covers a ground area corresponding to an irregular circle with a diameter of
about 20 feet and is nearly 10 feet tall.  It looks very old.

Rooms.Name: The Den of the Queen Spider
Rooms.Description:
You are inside a cave-like structure that seems to be made entirely from
countless layers of spider web. Temperature and humidity is very high making it
hard to breathe the foul air that lingers here. The walls are covered with open
cocoons.

Exits.Description: Compared to this place the east exit looks inviting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sticky walls are covered with open cocoons.

The cocoons are burst open as if something inside really wanted to get out.
They are at the size of a human head.

Exits.Description: The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.
The dusty trail leads south through the trees.
The dusty trail leads west through the trees.

The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.

The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant gray roots have broken up through its surface.

Rooms.Name: At the end of the trail through the deep, dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest. Ancient gray
trees loom all around you. To the west you notice a strange building it looks
like a tavern, and as you look north you can make out a stone tower in the
distance.

Exits.Description: You see a large tower.
The dusty trail leads east through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ancient gray giants seem to observe you silently.

Rooms.Name: Outside a cave in the deep, dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a broad, irregular path. To the north is a very large
ominous-looking cave opening. The trees here have many marks as if something
with huge claws has been tearing at them in rage.

Exits.Description: The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.
The path winds its way westward.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ancient gray giants have many marks as if something with huge claws has
been tearing at them in rage.
The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.

Rooms.Name: The cave of the Green Dragon
Rooms.Description:
You are in a big natural cave. The floor is littered with bones of all sorts
and the stench is so massive that you could cut it with a knife. The only exit
is to the south.

Exits.Description: The exit leads out into the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Most of the bones on the floor appear to be of human origin.

Rooms.Name: The narrow trail
Rooms.Description:
This trail looks much spookier than any other that you have seen. The usual
animal claw marks and bites on the trees are getting far and few between. The
trail continues north.

Exits.Description: the narrow trail continues north.
the trail intersects the main forest path.

Rooms.Name: The narrow trail
Rooms.Description:
This area of the trail is also very peculiar. You can see no signs of animal
life what so ever. The structure of the surrounding trees forces the path to
make a sharp turn to the east.

Exits.Description: the trail bends east.
the start of the trail.

Rooms.Name: The circle of trees
Rooms.Description:
The trees here seem to form a circle around one HUGE tree that is in the
center of them. You notice a wooden door carved into the huge tree to the east.
The trail that you followed to get here seems to end at the base of the tree.

Exits.Description: The tree door is carved beautifully.
the bend on the trail.

Rooms.Name: Inside the great tree
Rooms.Description:
You have stepped inside of this hollowed tree. From here steps lead down
into darkness or you can exit the tree by going west.

Exits.Description: The steps appears like they will hold your weight.
the door is carved beautifully.

Rooms.Name: The underground hallway
Rooms.Description:
This hallway is apparently one of the roots of the tree hollowed out. The
hall leads south to a room where you hear strange noises or you can go up the
steps.

Exits.Description: the steps appear like they will hold your weight.
the hallway looks quite grand.

Rooms.Name: The cultist temple
Rooms.Description:
This temple which is built to some god that you don't worship is a nice
place visit but you feel very uncomfortable about spending any amount of time
here. The wooden alter seems to almost glow as you enter the room. The only
exit is the way you came in.

Exits.Description: the hallway looks quite grand.

Rooms.Name: The Dead Part of the Forest
Rooms.Description:
The evergreen forest turns into a dead landscape here.  Rotten trees
and murky grass surround you.  The swampy makes you sink deeper with
each new step you make.  Crows are flying around, picking flesh from
skeletons which are all around.  The swamp path leads further to the
south.

Rooms.Name: Deep in the Dead Forest
Rooms.Description:
A thick fog floats just above the swamp.  You can't see through it,
hope that you don't in the wrong place.  You look around in fear, as you
notice something moving through the murky water.  Leafless trees are to
your right and left, blocking your view.  Two grim red eyes stare at you 
from a hollow in a dead oak tree.  The path continues to the south and
seems to lead into a clearing, from which the sound of unhuman screams
can be heard. Now, perhaps, is your last chance to return.

Rooms.Name: The Swampy Lake
Rooms.Description:
The path pours into a large swampy lake.  Thick fog prevents you from
seeing the opposite shore.  Horrific creatures crawl through the thick
fluid, wating for a kill.  Poles stick out from the swamp, each one with
a skull attached to the end.  In the middle of the swampy lake a black
mountain shoots into the sky.  It rears its ugly head high into the sky,
casting an ominous shadow beneath it.  Howling wolves and screaming
creatures can be heared from somwhere deep in the mountain.  The whole 
has a strange aura about it. It seems that you are in an place that is
totally isolated from the rest of the world.  A narrow stone bridge
leads to the black rock.  You notice a horned skull etched into the
black rock, and you realize that you have approached Shamhna territory.

Mobs.Name: warg vicious
Mobs.LongDescription: A vicious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
Mobs.Description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

Mobs.Name: warg ferocious
Mobs.LongDescription: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
Mobs.Description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

Mobs.Name: wolf grey
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, grey wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
Mobs.Description: The large, grey wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

Mobs.Name: wolf black
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, black wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
Mobs.Description: The large, black wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

Mobs.Name: tree ancient
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
Mobs.Description:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground. Something
about it makes you think that this is not a normal oak tree.

>
The enormous grey trunk shivers slightly, as if sighing deeply.

Mobs.LongDescription: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
Mobs.Description:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

Mobs.Name: spider poisonous
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge, poisonous spider is here.
Mobs.Description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a human crawling on all four.  It
has eight hairy legs that gives it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
and sharp poisonous fangs to paralyze or kill its prey.

Mobs.Name: queen spider
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
Mobs.Description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

Mobs.Name: shargugh brownie
Mobs.LongDescription: Shargugh the Forest Brownie is here, grinning broadly at you.
Mobs.Description:
This little fellow is only three foot tall with wild matted brown hair and long
tangled brown beard.  He wears ragged brown and green clothing and looks as if
he is having great fun.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 grin;%5 say Dont disturb the green dragon!

Mobs.Name: elder druid
Mobs.LongDescription: The elder druid is here.  He looks very upset about your presence in his home.
Mobs.Description:
The druid looks quite old.  You would think of him as venerable but yet you
know he would be a tough foe.

Objects.Name: tree opening
Objects.Description: A colossal tree blocks the way westward.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This enormous tree must be a thousand years old.  Its rough bark looks grey
and pale and is decorated with scratches and clawmarks.  On its west side is a
small opening just above ground level.

The opening is far too narrow for you to squeeze through but it looks as if the
tree is hollow.

Objects.Name: branch
Objects.Description: A long, grey branch rests heavily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is quite heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
long dead and very dry.  Could probably be lighted quite easily.

Objects.Name: branch
Objects.Description: A long, grey branch rests heavily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is very heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
long and straight and the wood is very hard, still being full of sap.  Although
it does not fit very well in your hand, it could be used as a clumsy but very
heavy weapon.

Objects.Name: branch
Objects.Description: A long, grey branch rests heavily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is very heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
somewhat twisted and the hard wood is still full of sap.

It is a large, brown boletus that must weigh nearly five pounds.  The top
surface is covered in a thin layer of transparent slime that emits a weak,
musty smell.  Not the most delicious thing you have seen.

It is a large, brown boletus that must weigh nearly five pounds.  It has small
white spots and the top surface is covered in a thin layer of transparent slime
that emits a weak, musty smell.  Not the most delicious thing you have seen.

Objects.Name: potion blue
Objects.Description: A blue potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has a nice deep blue color and a smell like peppermint.

Objects.Name: potion yellow musky
Objects.Description: A yellow potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has a deep yellow color and and a strong spicy smell.

Objects.Name: shield large
Objects.Description: A large round shield has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is made from hard wood that has been reinforced with heavy iron bands.

Objects.Name: crown iron
Objects.Description: An iron crown rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a heavy human-sized crown made from solid iron.

Objects.Name: scepter iron
Objects.Description: An iron scepter lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a heavy scepter made from solid iron.

Objects.Name: ring iron
Objects.Description: An iron ring has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a quite heavy human-sized ring made from solid iron.  It lacks
decorations of any kind.

Objects.Name: staff healing
Objects.Description: A strange staff is laying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: As you look closer you see some writings, use to heal your friends.

Objects.Name: morning-star star morning
Objects.Description: the morning star is here collecting dust while it lies on the ground.
